artifacts: Raw logs, traces, checkpoints, streams and observation tensors stay ignored under runs/api. After execution publish compact metrics/provenance and actual-training GIFs only. Keep technique-inventory.md as the sole generated goal leaderboard.

gates.retention: Not authorized by this protocol; separate passing smoke checkpoint dependency and predeclared tier2 budget required.
gates.smoke: Any scheduled full passing state plus one independent same-state confirmation satisfying every unchanged bound; both arms still finish1600updates.
gates.sustained_diagnostic: Also report unchanged five-terminal-full-pass reducer and longest passing streak; neither replaces smoke or confers ordinary qualification.

held_fixed: one protocol seed0; no seed sweep
uniform16-component 2D Gaussian target, ring radius3, sigma0.1
learned uniform256-row MoG prior, sigma0.1, standardizeFalse
BCAP penalty and normalized biases/sampled prior rows
constant G/D/prior rates and optimizer momentum0
recipe horizon400 and full1600 update cap
clean live serving through public prior without output noise or EMA

restored.role: original restart reproduction; distinct runtime path, not a fresh continuous candidate control

initializer: public deterministic orthogonal named initializer; public R2 table for prior

predictions.algebra: Matched-draw pair sensitivity may improve or worsen because weak singular bases themselves differ. Only finite/repeatable/RNG-isolated implementation behavior is gated here.
predictions.continuous: A confirmed smoke success with every-step flips would support a separately declared continuous-learning retention test; it would not establish stable convergence.
predictions.exploration: A boundary-only success would show that an isolated weak-direction perturbation can select another trajectory in this fixed experiment; it would not identify the original restart cause.

rng_contract.confirmation: one separate named evaluation confirmation stream, drawn only at first scheduled full passing state;4096 samples before any further update
rng_contract.data_and_prior: existing separate named training streams; checkpoint every consumed stream
rng_contract.matching: Initial model hashes and seen target-batch digests agree across candidates; boundary live400 matches original archived fresh public400-state after projecting only newly registered streams. Training-noise draws never advance data/prior/eval streams.
rng_contract.training_noise: Isolated checkpointed CUDA generator(noise, component=ring16_intervention, purpose=weak_directions); draw only for weak singular components; zero and no-weak matrices consume no draws.

saved_matrix_probe.backend: cuda float32; no CPU SVD or matrix dtype conversion
saved_matrix_probe.criterion: Finite factors, exact same-input/same-perturbation-state repeats, strong signs all+1, +/-1 weak signs, preserved ambient CPU/CUDA RNG, and checkpoint every consumed perturbation-stream state. Zero/no-weak fixtures have no draws. No mismatch-reduction or quality target is imposed.

fixed_algebra_fixtures.scope: separate fixed algebra cohort, never a learned initialization

historical_baseline.identity: PR331 original saved-gradient probe, CUDA SVD; original pair-norm summary used saved CPU tensors

saved_matrix_probe.new_pair_norm_backend: CUDA float32; report measured values, do not demand last-bit equality to historical CPU norm summary
saved_matrix_probe.paired_rng_contract: Restore only the perturbation stream to its initial checkpoint before each input and repeat; compare matched coin sequences, recording weak counts and signs. Different gradients can have different weak bases/counts.
saved_matrix_probe.rng_draws: Up to256 uniform values, drawn only on isolated named CUDA perturbation stream; no ambient/data/prior/eval draws.

schedule_contract.boundary_only: Fresh public initialization and live updates1..400 unchanged; flip weak G/D spectral signs only during update401; ordinary full polar402..1600. No restore.
schedule_contract.every_step: Fresh public initialization; draw independent weak spectral signs for each eligible G/D matrix update during1..1600. No restore.
schedule_contract.rationale: A single perturbation after the shared live400 prefix tests path selection at the restart boundary; every-step tests continuous random weak-direction exploration. Neither changes small individual model weights.

stopping_rules: Freeze source/protocol before paid work; every attempt counts, no retries or repeat of consumed arms.
Reject CPU backend, wrong matrix dtype/device, missing/wrong-device generator and nonfinite inputs; no CPU substitution for unavailable CUDA.
Finish both independent arms to1600 even if a smoke state passes.
Stop an arm on nonfinite training, source/stream mismatch, timeout or budget exhaustion; retain raw error and actual state/cost.
No seed changes, periodic restart, annealing, prior refresh, subbatch repeat, architecture change, flip-probability/threshold grid or relaxed covariance bounds.
Do not spend automatically on retention or import these diagnostic results into ordinary qualification.

trainer_delta.exact_zero_singular_components: For a nonzero rank-deficient matrix these are arbitrary unit completions in original polar; flipping them perturbs that normalized completion, not a nonzero gradient component.
trainer_delta.perturbation_distribution: one independent CUDA float32 U[0,1) value per weak component; sign=-1 if draw<0.5 else+1
trainer_delta.polar: U diag(signs) Vh, signs=+1 for s>tau; independent fair +/-1 signs for s<=tau
trainer_delta.rng: only passed isolated named CUDA noise/ ring16_intervention/ weak_directions generator; every consumed state checkpointed
trainer_delta.zero_gradient: exact zero direction, no RNG draws

user_authorization: User requested separate PRs/subagents for weak-value random sign flipping, and favored a single boundary intervention mirroring resume after400; compare that with every-step flips.
